CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH

--------
For the Petitioners : Mr. Vishal Kumar Rai, Advocate For the State : Mr. S. K. Tiwari, A.P.P  --------
04/ Dated 16.06.2023  Heard the parties.

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Chandankiyari P.S. Case No. 72 of 2022, for the offences under Sections 341, 323, 324, 326, 307, 498A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bokaro.
Petitioners are the cousins of the husband of the informant.
It is alleged that on 25.04.2022, there was some altercation between the family members of the informant and the accused persons, which resulted into free fight.
It was submitted that there is no specific allegation against the petitioners and similarly situated co-accused persons have been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in A.B.A. No.11338/2022.
Considering the aforesaid fact; I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

They are directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on their surrender shall release them on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bokaro, in Bidhan Gope @ Vidhan Gope @ Bidhan Kumar ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ..... ....
